text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the day of the Centaur Stakes. Once the race is over, Sakura Bakushin O will have run a combined 3,600 meters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Believing this win will make her a stayer, Sakura Bakushin O takes the stage with bated breath!
